name: The Reactor [Maintenance]
desc:
Small update, mind the time gap

[Lore] In the year 2057, a world-renowned research company known as 'Synthesis Manufacturing' puts you and your team of 4 in control of 'The Subspace Reactor.' Residing deep beneath the Icarus Installation, the reactor promises to completely revolutionize the energy industry as a whole, however, it would seem as if there are even bigger plans at stake.

[Info] This game is currently a mish-mash of various gameplay elements from a variety of different games, with the main goal being to achieve the quota, and shutdown the reactor. Cooperation with others is recommended (especially if you're new), but it is balanced for single player runs.

[Plans] Optimizations, EXTRA Update, Transition to BETA (Shifts 4&5)

[Note] Alpha = Numerous elements subject to change + Buggy spaghetti, also the repair guns might overload even if you successfully repair something
